_about: Metrics for surfaces that have no usable API, or whose API is not wired up yet.
The weekly report renders every metric listed here. A null value renders as
'not supplied' and is counted in the report's Data Gaps section - it is never
estimated, interpolated, or filled in from another source.
Update 'as_of' whenever you refresh values. Stale values are flagged by the report
once they are older than the period being reported on.

input_method_vocabulary.manual-export: A human downloads a CSV/screenshot from the vendor UI and types the number in here.
input_method_vocabulary.connector: An automated job writes this value. 'connector_id' names the script that owns it.
input_method_vocabulary.unavailable-no-api: Vendor exposes the metric in their UI only and publishes no API. Manual entry is the only option; do not build a scraper for it.

sections.label: Local / Map pack (Google Business Profile)
sections.source: GBP Performance API getDailyMetricsTimeSeries, or GBP UI > Performance export
sections.runbook: GBP UI > Performance > select location > date range > Download. One row per location. See README 'Local / map inputs'.

metrics.label: Total reviews
metrics.target: +2 to +4 new text reviews per month per staffed location

sections.label: Map-pack rank on core query
sections.source: Third-party geo-grid scan (e.g. Local Falcon). Quarterly cadence.
sections.runbook: Record the map-pack position for 'commercial glazing contractor <market>'. Do not query Google directly from CI - use the licensed geo-grid vendor's export.

sections.label: AI assistant visibility
sections.source: .github/scripts/ai-visibility.py (monthly workflow) writes the AI-Citations sheet tab; transcribe the monthly rate here.
sections.runbook: Run the 'AI Visibility (monthly)' workflow, then copy the per-engine cite rate from its Slack summary. No first-party citation reporting exists for these engines - the prompt panel in ai-visibility.py is the measurement.

sections.label: Bing Webmaster Tools
sections.source: BWT Search Performance (API available) + BWT AI Performance (preview, no API)
sections.runbook: Search Performance figures can be automated via the BWT API key already used by seo-pulse.py. AI Performance has no API - export it by hand from the BWT UI monthly.

sections.label: Google AI surfaces
sections.source: GSC Search Console gen-AI performance report
sections.runbook: GSC > Performance > Search results > Search Appearance. The gen-AI report is impressions-only, capped at 1,000 rows, and is not exposed by the Search Analytics API - export by hand monthly.
